sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Professional - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Being a champion is cool, but "warm-up champion" sounds pretty sad, don’t you think? Time to go pro. And pros play for real money, in serious fights where the stakes are higher. Go on, get used to that level."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Plant or deactivate the device 3 times in BlastGang mode
